template.unitsNote: Write the unit exactly as it appears here, by name or abbreviation and without plural.
template.instructions:
How to fill in the template
• Insumos (products) sheet: one row per product. Nombre and Unidad are required (marked with *).
• Unidad: the name or abbreviation, as they appear in the Unidades sheet.
• Categoría: created if it does not exist.
• Rendimiento %: how much of what you buy is usable. 90 = 900 g out of 1 kg.
• IVA % (optional): the VAT rate the product is invoiced with: 0, 2.5, 5, 10.5, 21 or 27. "21", "10,5" or "21%" all work. Empty = not set.
• Recetas (recipes) sheet: one row per ingredient. Sale price and menu section go in the first row of each dish.
• Cantidad: what ONE dish takes, in the unit of that row.
• The ingredient must be an existing product or one in the Insumos sheet.
• If the dish already exists, its recipe is replaced by the file's; price and menu section don't change.
• Numbers can be written as 1.234,5 or 1,5.
• Don't leave examples or notes in the Insumos and Recetas sheets: everything there is imported.
